ActiveViewName.summary: Any interactive view should have an accessible name available for assistive technologies such as TalkBack and Voice Access.

CheckBoxName.summary: Any CheckBox element should have an accessible name available for assistive technologies such as TalkBack and Voice Access.

ColorContrast.summary: Ensures that each text element has a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio with its background and that large text has a minimum 3.0:1 contrast ratio.

EditTextName.summary: Text input elements should have an accessible name available for assistive technologies such as TalkBack and Voice Access.

EditTextValue.summary: Text input elements should have its value available for assistive technologies such as TalkBack and Voice Access.

FocusableText.summary: Views containing text should be focusable for assistive technologies such as TalkBack.

ImageViewName.summary: Focusable image elements should provide a meaningful accessible name available for assistive technologies such as TalkBack and Voice Access.

InaccessibleAction.summary: Interactive elements should be focusable with assistive technology and contain descriptive text.

LabelAtFront.summary: Visible text associated with an interactive element should be stated at the beginning of that element's speakable text.

LabelInName.summary: An accessibility focusable view should ensure its name includes its visible label.

NestedActiveControl.summary: An accessibility element should not have multiple active controls embedded within it. Each active control should be individually focused and interacted with.

NestedElementName.summary: A focusable view should have all visible text within its accessible name available for assistive technologies such as TalkBack and Voice Access.

ScreenOrientation.summary: Views should adhere to the user's preferred display orientation.

ScreenTitle.summary: Every screen within an application should provide a title to be announced by assistive technology.

SwitchName.summary: Any Switch element should have an accessible name available for assistive technologies such as TalkBack and Voice Access.

TouchSizeWcag.summary: An interactive element's visual and tappable areas should have a height and width of at least 44dp.

TouchTargetSpacing.summary: Both the height and width of an interactive element should be at least 24dp, or the interactive element should be positioned such that if a circle with a diameter of 24dp were placed at its center, it would not intersect with another interactive element or the circle of another undersized interactive element.

children.text: Air quality is expected to be acceptable; however, for some pollutants there may be a moderate health concern for a very small number of people. For example, people who are unusually sensitive to ozone may experience respiratory symptoms. This daily air quality forecast summarizes conditions expected over the entire day. Hourly air quality predictions are also available.
